1.ARALING PANLIPUNAN:
- Nilalaman: Ganap at kaugnay na lokasyon (absolute/relative location) ng Pilipinas sa mundo at sa Timog-Silangang Asya; batayan ng pambansang teritoryo (kapuluan, karagatang teritoryal); heyograpiyang pisikal (kabundukan, ilog, katubigan) at heyograpiyang pantao (populasyon, pamamahagi ng mamamayan).
- Kasanayang Pampagkatuto: Paglalarawan sa lokasyon at hugis ng Pilipinas gamit ang mapa; pagtukoy sa mga rehiyon, lalawigan, at pangunahing anyong-lupa at anyong-tubig; pagpapaliwanag sa ugnayan ng heograpiya sa pamumuhay ng mga Pilipino.
1.ENGLISH:
- Listening and Reading (EN4LR-I): Listening to and reading enumeration-description texts about mealtimes and birthday celebrations; identifying the topic and listing details in the order presented; decoding multisyllabic words with common affixes; reading grade-level text with appropriate rate, accuracy, and expression.
- Speaking and Writing (EN4SW-I): Composing an enumeration-description paragraph about a family mealtime or birthday tradition; writing a friendly letter of excuse or invitation using correct parts (heading, salutation, body, closing); using vocabulary and simple/compound sentences appropriate to the topic.
- Viewing and Representing (EN4VR-I): Interpreting photos, menus, or invitation cards related to mealtimes and celebrations; identifying the purpose of visual design choices in an invitation.
1.EPP (ICT):
- Introduction to Computer: Kahalagahan ng computer at computing devices; mga bahagi ng Computer System; basic computer operations — booting and shutting down computer, keyboarding techniques, mouse techniques.
- Digital Citizenship: Digital health and wellness; online security and safety.
- Word Processing Software: User interface; page size, orientation, and margin; font type, style, size, and color; text alignment.
- Presentation Software: User interface; page design/theme; inserting and formatting textbox, WordArt, shapes, and images.
- Desktop Publishing Software: User interface; templates; inserting and formatting textbox, WordArt, shapes, and images.
- Spreadsheet Software: User interface; borders; basic formula (MDAS).
1.FILIPINO:
- Pakikinig at Pagbasa: Pakikinig at pagbasa ng alamat, pabula, parabula, at anekdota; pagtukoy ng paksa at mga detalyeng naglalarawan dito; pagbasa nang may wastong bilis, kawastuhan, at ekspresyon.
- Pagsasalita at Pagsulat: Muling pagsasalaysay ng alamat o pabula gamit ang sariling mga salita; pagsulat ng talatang naglalarawan (deskriptibo) tungkol sa isang tauhan, lugar, o pangyayari sa binasang kuwento.
- Panonood at Presentasyon: Panonood at pagsusuri ng larawan o ilustrasyon na kaugnay ng alamat o pabula; pagbibigay-kahulugan sa mensahe ng ilustrasyon.
- Gramatika: Unlapi, gitlapi, at hulapi (mag-, nag-, -um-, -in, -an); wastong paggamit ng mga ito sa pagbuo ng pangungusap.
1.GMRC:
- Wk1-2: Sariling Kakayahang Mag-isip at Magmahal na Natatangi sa Tao. Pagbibigay-halaga sa mga sariling kakayahan na wala sa ibang nilalang (hal. kakayahang magpasiya, umunawa ng damdamin ng iba). Pagpapahalaga: Pagpapahalaga sa Sarili.
- Wk3-4: Mga Sariling Gawi ng Mabuting Pakikitungo sa mga Kasapi ng Pamilya. Angkop na paglalahad ng tunay na saloobin sa mga kasapi ng pamilya. Pagpapahalaga: Matapat.
- Wk5-6: Sariling Tungkulin sa Pagkilala sa Karapatan ng Kapuwa-Bata. Pakikilahok sa mga gawaing kumikilala sa karapatan ng kapuwa-bata. Pagpapahalaga: Magalang.
- Wk7-8: Pagkilala sa Sariling Pananampalataya. Mga paraan ng pagsamba at pagsunod sa mga tagubilin ng kinabibilangang pananampalataya. Pagpapahalaga: Pananalig sa Diyos.
- Wk9-10: Mga Sariling Gawi sa Pangangalaga sa mga Puno at Halaman. Paglahok sa mga gawaing pangangalaga at pagpaparami ng mga puno at halaman. Pagpapahalaga: Mapanagutan.
- Wk11-13: Sariling Kamalayan sa mga Mabuting Kaugaliang Pilipino. Mga gawain na nagtatampok sa mga Pilipinong nagsasabuhay ng mabuting kaugalian (masayahin, madasalin, masipag). Pagpapahalaga: Pagmamahal sa Bayan.
1.MAPEH:
- Music: Timbre (vocal/instrumental) and dynamics (level of dynamics) as heard in local musical performances; active listening and performing (singing, chanting, playing instruments).
- Arts (Theater/Dance): Elements of artistic expression (lines, shapes, space, rhythm, sound, movement, color) and principles of composition (balance, proportion, scale) as seen in local cultural performances and dance forms.
- Visual Arts: Visual elements and forms, balance/proportion/scale, using local materials and practices.
- Personal Health: Concept and importance of personal health for active living; proper personal hygiene practices (handwashing, care of sense organs, oral care, body care, genital care); relating current health status to body awareness through health appraisal procedures (height/weight/BMI, hearing test, vision screening, scoliosis test, dental exam).
- PE — Target Games: Performing physical activities using target-game concepts (positioning, sending/propelling an object to an intended area) with agility, balance, coordination, and speed, through Philippine traditional games (Tatsing, Calahoyo, Tumbang Preso, Tamaang-Tao, Batuhang Bola, Bati-Cobra).
1.MATHEMATICS:
- Wk1-2: Angles. Illustrating right, acute, and obtuse angles using models; measuring and drawing angles using a protractor.
- Wk3-4: Triangles and quadrilaterals. Drawing triangles and quadrilaterals and stating their properties; classifying triangles and quadrilaterals according to sides and angles; differentiating the types of quadrilaterals.
- Wk5: Perimeter. Finding the perimeter of quadrilaterals that are not squares or rectangles, and of composite figures made up of triangles and quadrilaterals.
- Wk6-7: Numbers up to 1,000,000. Reading and writing numbers up to 1,000,000 in numerals and in words; determining the place value and value of a digit in a 6-digit number.
- Wk8: Comparing and rounding. Comparing numbers up to 1,000,000 using =, <, and >; rounding numbers to the nearest hundred thousand.
- Wk9-10: Estimating, adding, and subtracting. Estimating the sum and difference of two 5- to 6-digit numbers by rounding; adding numbers with sums up to 1,000,000 and subtracting numbers where both are less than 1,000,000, with and without regrouping.
1.SCIENCE:
- Wk1-2: Science inventions. Using secondary sources to identify a famous Filipino and/or foreign scientist and their invention/s; identifying a science invention from home or the local community and explaining its impact on everyday life.
- Wk3-4: Chemical properties of materials. Describing chemical properties of materials — that they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable; describing changes in properties of materials when exposed to temperature changes, such as burning wood or coal.
- Wk5-6: Handling materials safely. Demonstrating ways to minimize harmful changes in materials, such as restricting the burning of waste materials and taking care when handling reactive materials.
- Wk7-8: Gathering scientific information. Identifying issues and concerns in the local community and how they could be addressed by science, such as waste treatment; applying science process skills (grouping, classifying, communicating, open-mindedness) in a guided survey about environmental issues.
- Wk9-10: Term project. Creating a simple model, illustration, or story about a favorite science invention used in everyday life, or planning and producing a sample of useful fertilizer from household waste.

2.ARALING PANLIPUNAN:
- Nilalaman: Mga likas na yaman at gawaing pangkabuhayan ng bansa (agrikultura, pangingisda, industriya, turismo); konsepto ng sustainable development at pangangalaga sa kapaligiran bilang bahagi ng patuloy na kaunlarang pangkabuhayan.
- Kasanayang Pampagkatuto: Pagtukoy sa mga pangunahing gawaing pangkabuhayan sa iba't ibang bahagi ng bansa at ang kaugnayan nito sa likas na yaman; pagpapaliwanag sa kahalagahan ng matalinong paggamit ng yaman para sa kinabukasan; pagsusuri ng epekto ng mga desisyong pangkabuhayan sa kapaligiran at komunidad.
2.ENGLISH:
- Listening and Reading (EN4LR-II): Listening to and reading time-order (chronological/procedural) texts about christening and wedding customs; sequencing steps or events correctly; continued vocabulary building with content-specific and ceremonial terms.
- Speaking and Writing (EN4SW-II): Writing a short procedural or chronological text describing the steps or order of events in a christening or wedding; composing a friendly letter of pagbati (greeting/congratulations) for such an occasion, using appropriate polite expressions.
- Viewing and Representing (EN4VR-II): Analyzing photographs or programs from ceremonies for sequence and purpose; representing a sequence of events using a simple graphic organizer (flow chart).
2.EPP (AFA/FCS/IA):
- Kahalagahan ng Paghahalaman: Content: Kahalagahan at kabutihang-dulot ng paghahalaman sa tao (stress reliever, medicinal value, napagkakakitaan, nagbibigay ng sariwang hangin/tubig/pagkain); sa hayop (sariwang hangin, tubig, pagkain); sa kalikasan o kapaligiran (nakapipigil sa baha at pagguho ng lupa, naiiwasan ang polusyon, nagbibigay ng lilim at sariwang hangin, nagpapaganda ng kapaligiran).
- Mga batas, lokal na ordinansa, ahensya ng gobyerno at NGOs: Content: Mga piling batas (National Law-RA 10068, Organic Agriculture Act of 2010, Ecological Solid Waste Management Act, local ordinances); mga ahensiya (DA, DENR, DTI, DOLE, DOST, TESDA); mga NGO (FAO, MASIPAG, AgriCOOPh).
- Mga taong matagumpay sa paghahalaman: Content: Mga kilalang magsasaka at entrepreneur sa paghahalaman sa Pilipinas; mga katangian na taglay (masipag, maparaan, masigasig, matiyaga, may dedikasyon, malakas ang loob, may kakayahan sa pagpapalano).
- Compost, organikong pataba at natural na pestisidyo: Content: Paggawa ng compost (paraan, mga nilalaman, katangian ng magandang compost, vermicomposting); organic concoctions and extracts (FFJ, FPJ, FAA, BOKASHI); natural pestisidyo (OHN 1: white vinegar, bawang, molasses; OHN 2: luya, sibuyas, bawang, molasses, sili; Neem tree oil).
- Mga salik na dapat isaalang-alang sa paghahalaman: Content: Mga panuntunang pangkaligtasan at pangkalusugan sa paghahalaman; kagamitan at kasangkapan at paraan ng pag-iingat; mga salik (lugar, uri ng lupa, uri ng halamang itatanim, partial shade/full sun, suplay ng tubig, pataba, panahon/kalendaryo ng pagtatanim, pagtatala ng gastos).
- Pagtatanim ng halaman sa natural na pamamaraan: Content: Pagpili ng halamang maaaring itanim (halamang ornamental — san francisco, bougainvillea, cactus, rose, santan; halamang-gulay — talong, kamatis, sili, kalabasa, kamote, kangkong, okra, pipino, pechay; punong-prutas — manga, santol, rambutan); paraan ng pagtatanim (tuwiran at di-tuwiran); paggamit ng mga kagamitan at kasangkapan; mga hakbang sa pagtatanim (gumawa ng plano/layout, suriin at linisin ang lugar, bungkalin ang lupa, haluan ng organikong pataba, patagin gamit ang kalaykay, simulan ang pagtatanim, diligan).
2.EPP (ICT): - Term 2 = Agriculture and Fishery Arts (AFA); Term 3 = Family and Consumer Science (FCS) + Industrial Arts (IA). All are covered in the companion EPP (AFA/FCS/IA) budget-of-work entry.
2.FILIPINO:
- Pakikinig at Pagbasa: Pakikinig at pagbasa ng anekdota, tulang pambata, at kuwentong-bayan; pagtukoy ng pagkakasunod-sunod ng mga pangyayari sa isang recount o talambuhay.
- Pagsasalita at Pagsulat: Pagsulat ng sariling talaarawan (personal na karanasan sa loob ng isang araw o linggo); pagsulat ng maikling talambuhay ng sarili, kasama ang mahahalagang detalye tungkol sa sariling buhay.
- Panonood at Presentasyon: Pagsasalaysay nang pasalita ng isang personal na karanasan gamit ang tamang pagkakasunod-sunod at ekspresyon.
- Gramatika: Pangngalan, panghalip, at pang-uri — mga kayarian (payak, maylapi, tambalan, inuulit); wastong paggamit sa pagsulat ng talaarawan.
2.GMRC:
- Wk1-2: Pagpapaunlad ng Sariling Kakayahan, Talento at Hilig nang may Paggabay ng Pamilya. Paglahok sa mga programang pampaaralan na nagpapaunlad ng mga kakayahan, talento at hilig. Pagpapahalaga: Tiwala sa Sarili.
- Wk3-4: Pagtupad sa mga Gawain sa Pamilya nang May Kahusayan. Palagiang paggawa ng mga gawaing bukas sa mungkahi ng miyembro ng pamilya. Pagpapahalaga: Matiyaga.
- Wk5-6: Pamilya bilang Pinagmumulan ng Maayos na Komunikasyon sa Kapuwa. Angkop na pananalita at pagtugon sa kapuwa nang may pagsasaalang-alang sa damdamin. Pagpapahalaga: Mapagpasensiya.
- Wk7-8: Pagbibigay-halaga sa Pamilya Bilang Paglalapat ng mga Aral ng Pananampalataya. Mapagkalingang pakikitungo sa mga kasapi ng pamilya. Pagpapahalaga: Masunurin.
- Wk9-10: Tungkulin ng Pamilya sa Pagpapanatili ng Kalinisan ng Tubig. Paglahok sa mga gawain ng pamilya na nagpapanatili ng kalinisan ng tubig. Pagpapahalaga: Mabuting Katiwala.
- Wk11-13: Pagpapatatag sa mga Gawi sa Pamilya ayon sa Kaugaliang Pilipino. Pagtugon sa pagpapatatag ng mga gawi sa pamilya ayon sa kaugaliang Pilipino. Pagpapahalaga: Pagmamahal sa Bayan.
2.MAPEH:
- Music: Rhythm (beat, rhythmic pattern) and tempo, explored through local music tied to faiths and beliefs; moving to and improvising rhythmic patterns.
- Arts (Theater/Dance): Elements and principles of composition focused on rhythm/pattern and movement, as seen in local traditional rituals and religious/spiritual dance forms.
- Visual Arts: Visual elements and principles of rhythm and pattern, movement.
- Family Health: Characteristics and importance of a healthy family (respecting members' opinions, fair rules, open communication); demonstrating one's roles and responsibilities in promoting family health; physical/daily-life activities that improve family health (dance, exercise, cooking together, gardening).
- PE — Invasion Games: Performing physical activities using invasion-game concepts (attacking by creating/moving into space, defending by denying space) with agility, balance, and coordination, through Philippine traditional games (Agawan Base, Agawan Sulok, Lawin at Sisiw, Patintero, Langit-Lupa).
2.MATHEMATICS:
- Wk11-12: Multiplication. Multiplying 3- to 4-digit numbers by a 1-digit number, and 2- to 3-digit numbers by 2-digit numbers, with and without regrouping, for products up to 1,000,000; estimating products.
- Wk13-14: Division. Dividing 3- to 4-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers, and 2- to 3-digit numbers by 2-digit numbers, with and without regrouping; estimating quotients by rounding dividends and divisors to multiples of 10.
- Wk15: MDAS and multi-step problems. Representing situations using a number sentence; performing two or more operations by applying the MDAS rules; solving multi-step word problems involving one or more of the four operations, including money.
- Wk16-17: Converting units. Converting units of length (m/cm, km/m), mass (kg/g, g/mg), and capacity (L/mL) from larger to smaller and vice versa; converting time measures (seconds to years); solving problems involving unit conversion, including elapsed time in hours and minutes.
- Wk18-20: Similar fractions. Identifying proper fractions, improper fractions, and mixed numbers; rewriting improper fractions as mixed numbers and vice versa; plotting fractions on a number line; adding and subtracting similar fractions (including mixed numbers, and a whole number with a fraction).
2.SCIENCE:
- Wk11-12: Body systems. Describing in simple terms how the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory systems work in animals and humans.
- Wk13-14: Plant systems. Observing the root and shoot system in plants and describing why they are important.
- Wk15-16: Habitats. Classifying Philippine animals and plants based on habitat — terrestrial (land), aquatic (water), or aerial (air); listing examples of animals and plants in a particular habitat such as a garden, rice field, seashore, or mangrove swamp.
- Wk17-18: Life cycles. Using flow charts to compare the different stages in the life cycle of animals such as a butterfly, frog, chicken, and human.
- Wk19-20: Food chains. Grouping animals according to the food they eat — herbivores, carnivores, and omnivores; drawing a simple food chain using living things from the Philippines and labeling them by feeding group.

3.ARALING PANLIPUNAN:
- Nilalaman: Mga elemento ng pagkabansa (teritoryo, mamamayan, pamahalaan, soberanya); sistema ng unitary presidential government at paghahati ng kapangyarihan (executive, legislative, judicial); mga serbisyong ibinibigay ng pamahalaan batay sa pambansang badyet.
- Kasanayang Pampagkatuto: Pagtukoy sa tatlong sangay ng pamahalaan at kani-kanilang tungkulin; pagpapaliwanag kung paano nakatutulong ang mga serbisyo ng pamahalaan (edukasyon, kalusugan, imprastraktura) sa pang-araw-araw na buhay ng mamamayan; pagsusuri ng isang simpleng badyet ng pamahalaan.
- Nilalaman: Mga sagisag pambansa (watawat, pambansang awit, pambansang ibon/bulaklak) at kahalagahan nito sa pagkakakilanlan; konsepto ng pagkamamamayan at ang mga karapatang sibil, pampulitika, at panlipunan-pangkabuhayan ng bawat Pilipino; kapakanang sibiko (civic welfare) bilang pananagutan ng bawat mamamayan.
- Kasanayang Pampagkatuto: Pagpapaliwanag sa kahulugan at kasaysayan ng mga sagisag pambansa; pagtukoy sa mga karapatan at tungkulin ng isang mamamayang Pilipino; pagpapamalas ng pakikilahok sa mga gawaing sibiko sa paaralan o komunidad bilang responsableng mamamayan.
3.ENGLISH:
- Listening and Reading (EN4LR-III): Listening to and reading recount texts (retelling of past events) about funerals or symposia/gatherings; identifying the sequence of past events and the writer's/speaker's purpose; distinguishing recount from procedural and enumeration-description structures.
- Speaking and Writing (EN4SW-III): Composing a short recount paragraph about a past family or community gathering; writing a friendly letter of pakikiramay (condolence), using respectful and empathetic language appropriate to the context.
- Viewing and Representing (EN4VR-III): Viewing and discussing images or short clips from community gatherings, identifying mood and purpose conveyed through visuals.
- Listening and Reading (EN4LR-IV): Listening to and reading recount texts about national holidays and their significance; identifying cause-and-effect relationships between historical events and present-day celebrations.
- Speaking and Writing (EN4SW-IV): Writing a recount paragraph about a national holiday celebration, connecting personal or family experience to the holiday's historical significance; composing a friendly letter of pasasalamat (thanks) using all four friendly-letter types learned across the year (excuse/invitation, pagbati, pakikiramay, pasasalamat).
- Viewing and Representing (EN4VR-IV): Interpreting posters, historical photos, or short videos about national holidays; creating a simple visual (poster or timeline) representing a national holiday's history and meaning.
3.EPP (AFA/FCS/IA):
- Tungkulin sa Sarili: Kahalagahan ng pag-aayos at pangangalaga sa sarili; angkop na pagkilos sa panahon ng pagdadalaga at pagbibinata; angkop na pananamit.
- Tungkuling Pantahanan: Kagamitan sa pagsasaing (conventional at makabagong pamamaraan); mga hakbang sa pagsasaing; mga panukalang pangkaligtasan at pangkalusugan; kagamitan at consumable sa paghuhugas ng pinaglutuan at pinagkainan; mga hakbang sa paghuhugas; kagamitan at consumable sa paglilinis ng tahanan; pagliligpit ng mga kagamitan at consumables; mga hakbang sa paglilinis ng silid-tulugan, sala, kusina at bakuran; kagamitan at consumables sa paglalaba (conventional at makabagong pamamaraan); mga hakbang sa paglalaba; kagamitan sa pamamalantsa (conventional at makabagong pamamaraan); mga hakbang sa pamamalantsa.
- Kasangkapan at materyales sa pagguhit: 1. Nakikilala ang mga kasangkapan at materyales sa pagguhit.
- System of Measurement: Content: Dalawang sistema ng pagsukat (English at Metric System); pagbasa ng gradwasyon; unit conversion (English sa metric at metric sa English).
- Free-hand Drawing: Content: Basic sketching techniques; outlining; shading.
- Lettering Styles: Content: Iba't ibang lettering styles; hakbang sa pagsulat ng iba't ibang lettering styles.
- Alphabet of Lines: Content: Iba't ibang alphabet of lines; hakbang sa pagguhit ng alphabet of lines.
- Orthographic Drawing: Content: Orthographic views; hakbang sa pagguhit ng Orthographic Drawing.
3.FILIPINO:
- Pakikinig at Pagbasa: Pakikinig at pagbasa ng mito, epiko, tulang pambata, at kuwentong kababalaghan; pagtukoy ng mensahe at paksa ng bawat uri ng teksto.
- Pagsasalita at Pagsulat: Pagsulat ng maikling talambuhay ng isang taong may ambag sa lipunan o komunidad (hal. bayani, guro, o lider), batay sa nasaliksik na impormasyon.
- Panonood at Presentasyon: Pagbibigay-puna sa isang maikling dula-dulaan o pagbasang-malakas ng mito o epiko; pagkilala sa paggamit ng tinig at kilos sa pagsasalaysay.
- Gramatika: Panghalip pananong at panaklaw; pang-uring pamilang; wastong paggamit sa pagbuo ng mga tanong tungkol sa talambuhay ng bayani.
- Pakikinig at Pagbasa: Pakikinig at pagbasa ng tekstong may hakbang o proseso (hal. paggawa ng isang bagay, paraan ng paglalaro ng laro ng lahi); pagsunod sa pagkakasunod-sunod ng mga hakbang.
- Pagsasalita at Pagsulat: Pagsulat ng maikling teksto ng panuto o proseso (hal. paano gawin ang isang lutuin o proyekto) gamit ang wastong pananda ng pagkakasunod-sunod (una, pangalawa, sa huli).
- Panonood at Presentasyon: Panonood ng maikling video o larawang nagpapakita ng isang proseso, at pagsusuri kung kumpleto at wasto ang pagkakasunod-sunod ng mga hakbang.
- Gramatika: Panghalip pamanggit; pang-uring pamilang pamahalagi; kaantasan ng pang-uri (lantay); wastong paggamit sa pagsulat ng panuto.
3.GMRC:
- Wk1-2: Pagtitipid at Pag-iimpok para Makatulong sa Kapuwa. Pagtatabi ng bahagi ng baong pera/allowance o gamit na maaaring makatulong sa sarili o kapuwa. Pagpapahalaga: Matipid.
- Wk3-4: Pagtupad ng Tungkulin ng Pamilya sa Kapuwa. Pakikiisa sa pamilya sa pagtugon sa pangangailangan ng kapuwa (bukas-palad, pakikiramay, pagtuturo sa mga batang walang magulang). Pagpapahalaga: Mapagmalasakit.
- Wk5-6: Pagkakapantay-pantay ng Bawat Isa sa Kabila ng Pagkakaiba-iba. Pantay-pantay na pakikipag-ugnayan sa kabila ng pagkakaiba-iba, walang pagtatangi. Pagpapahalaga: Magalang.
- Wk7-8: Kababaang-loob sa Kapuwa Bilang Tanda ng Pananampalataya. Regular na pananalangin, kusang pag-amin sa mga nagawang kamalian, pagkilala na lahat ay magkakapantay-pantay. Pagpapahalaga: Mapagpakumbaba.
- Wk9-10: Pagpapanatili ng Kalinisan sa Kapaligiran Katuwang ang Kapuwa upang Makaiwas sa mga Sakit. Pagtupad sa mga nakatakdang gawain ng paglilinis sa sariling tahanan at paaralan. Pagpapahalaga: Kalinisan.
- Wk11-13: Mga Laro ng Lahi Kasama ang Kapuwa-bata. Pagpapalaganap ng mga Laro ng Lahi na nagpapakita ng kultura ng rehiyong kinabibilangan. Pagpapahalaga: Nasyonalismo.
- Wk14: Sariling Pagkilala sa mga Natatanging Taong May Kapansanan o Persons with Disability (PWD) sa Pamayanan. Paggamit sa mga kontribusyon ng mga PWD bilang gabay sa pasiya at kilos. Pagpapahalaga: Mapagpasalamat.
- Wk15: Pagtupad ng Pamilya sa mga Alituntunin ng Pamayanan. Panghihikayat sa iba na tumalima sa mga alituntunin sa pamayanan. Pagpapahalaga: Masunurin.
- Wk16: Mga Mabuting Katangian ng Lider-Estudyante na Makatutulong sa Pamayanan. Pangingilatis ng mga pipiliing lider-estudyante batay sa katangian ng mabuting pamumuno. Pagpapahalaga: Karunungan.

- Wk18: Pangangalaga sa mga Hayop Bilang Bahagi ng Kapaligiran. Pagiging sensitibo at pagtugon sa pangangailangan ng mga hayop. Pagpapahalaga: Mapagmalasakit.
- Wk19-20: Mga Makasaysayang Lugar sa Pamayanang Kinabibilangan. Interes at kamalayan sa kasaysayan ng mga lugar bilang unang hakbang sa pagpapalaganap ng mga ito. Pagpapahalaga: Nasyonalismo.

- Music: Form (strophic, free-form) and texture (thin/thick), drawn from music used in local celebrations; performing and active listening.

- Visual Arts: Basis for choosing colors/materials for festivals and celebrations, with principles of emphasis and subordination.
- Consumer Health: Child's basic health rights; Filipino consumer rights and responsibilities (right to basic needs, safety, information, right to choose; critical awareness, environmental awareness); decision-making, assertiveness, and critical-thinking skills to be an informed consumer; effects of health/fitness fads.
- PE — Rhythmic Activities and Dances: Fundamental Dance Steps and Social Dance Mixers in 3/4 time, building movement competence.
- Year-end project: Produce a creative work (Music & Arts) based on a celebration from the learner's own province/region, alongside a PE/Health rhythmic-activity showcase, combining skills built across the year.
3.MATHEMATICS:
- Wk21-22: Dissimilar and equivalent fractions. Representing and comparing dissimilar fractions (denominators up to 10) using models and the symbols =, >, <; ordering dissimilar fractions; generating and determining equivalent fractions; reducing fractions to simplest form.
- Wk23: Factors and multiples. Identifying multiples of given numbers up to 100; finding all factors of a given number up to 100.
- Wk24-25: Adding and subtracting dissimilar fractions. Adding and subtracting dissimilar fractions (two proper fractions, two mixed numbers, a mixed number and a proper fraction, a whole number and a proper/mixed fraction) using models and algorithms; solving multi-step word problems involving addition/subtraction of fractions.
- Wk26-27: Symmetry and reflection. Identifying symmetry with respect to a line; completing a figure that is symmetric with respect to a line; drawing the image of an object after reflection with respect to a line, including glide reflection.
- Wk28: Patterns and number sentences. Describing the rule used to generate a simple pattern; completing a number sentence to represent a property of operations (e.g., commutative property) or an equivalent number fact.
- Wk29-30: Data in tables and line graphs. Collecting data with a time element from appropriate sources; presenting data in tabular form or a single line graph; interpreting data presented in a table or line graph; solving problems using data for at most two variables.
- Wk31-33: Decimal numbers. Representing decimal numbers using models to show their relationship to fractions; reading and writing decimals to hundredths; determining place value and value of a digit to hundredths; converting decimals to fractions and fractions (denominators 10 or 100) to decimals; plotting decimals with a tenths part on a number line.
- Wk34-35: Comparing, ordering, and rounding decimals. Comparing and ordering decimal numbers to hundredths; rounding decimals to the nearest whole number and nearest tenth.
3.SCIENCE:
- Wk21-22: Forces and movement. Discovering and predicting how rigid and soft objects can be moved and/or changed in shape; measuring distance and time when things move using simple equipment; identifying that how far an object moves in a given time is called speed; constructing and labeling simple speed graphs.
- Wk23-24: Pushes, pulls, and shape. Demonstrating that pushes and pulls change the speed and direction of an object (faster, slower, turning, stopping); determining how forces change the shape of objects (pushed, pulled, stretched, bent, twisted, squeezed).
- Wk25-26: Magnets. Investigating the properties of magnets, including how they affect other magnets and objects made of different materials; identifying examples of objects affecting each other without contact, such as magnets attracting objects, sunlight affecting eyes and skin, and loud noises affecting ears.
- Wk27-28: Sound, light, and heat energy. Identifying that energy is something that can cause change, including light, sound, and heat energy; observing and identifying sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy at school, at home, and in the local community.
- Wk29-30: Term project. Developing a poster showing sources and uses of heat energy at home or in the neighborhood, or collaborating on a safety guide explaining how to stay safe around intense light and sound.
- Wk31-32: Soils. Comparing different types of soil — sandy, clay, silt, and loam — including comparing their ability to hold water; recognizing water as a basic need of plants and animals.
- Wk33-34: Soil and plant growth. Investigating the effect of different types of soil on the growth of plants.
- Wk35-36: Weather instruments. Identifying basic characteristics used to describe weather — air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, and cloud cover; using weather instruments to measure and record weather characteristics during a school day.
- Wk37-38: Reading and interpreting weather. Examining a local weather chart to make simple interpretations about local weather and how it might change; describing and practicing safety precautions during poor or extreme weather conditions.
- Wk39-40: The Sun. Describing overall characteristics of the Sun — its composition, size, and the energy it radiates; describing changes in the direction and length of shadows to infer why the Sun changes position during a day; explaining the Sun's importance to living things.
